title: Continous Assessment In Primary Education
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the point or score value for the correct response to each item."
The weight is the point or score value for the correct response to each item.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the class with half the number of scores."
Note that the median class is the class with half the number of scores.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the major and most commonly used instrument for continuous assessment."
Test is the major and most commonly used instrument for continuous assessment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are called restricted type because it calls for short, check, tick, mark answers."
The closed ended questionnaires are called restricted type because it calls for short, check, tick, mark answers.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used for appropriate guidance of the pupils with regards to choice and preparation for career."
Data from continuous assessment are used for appropriate guidance of the pupils with regards to choice and preparation for career.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the conversion of the raw scores into meaningful ratings of quality."
Grading is the conversion of the raw scores into meaningful ratings of quality.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is that which allows pupils to select, organize, integrate and synthesis their answers or responses in order to present them in their own styles and their own words."
An essay item is that which allows pupils to select, organize, integrate and synthesis their answers or responses in order to present them in their own styles and their own words.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the Z-scores, T-score and Stanines."
The standard scores are the Z-scores, T-score and Stanines.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the positioning of pupils in a class in terms of the scores they obtained in a test or examination."
Ranking is defined as the positioning of pupils in a class in terms of the scores they obtained in a test or examination.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very important part of teaching and learning process ii."
Assessment is a very important part of teaching and learning process ii.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a deviation from the mean divided by the standard deviation."
The Z-score is a deviation from the mean divided by the standard deviation.
fib: ______ is a technique by which relevant information is obtained from a person through direct oral questioning of a conversational nature. ii.
interview
An interview is a technique by which relevant information is obtained from a person through direct oral questioning of a conversational nature. ii.
______ is the lowest level of the affective domain.
Receiving
Receiving is the lowest level of the affective domain.
______ are the points which divide a distribution of scores into four equal parts.
quartile
The quartile are the points which divide a distribution of scores into four equal parts.
______ is the least reliable type of statistical average.
mode
The mode is the least reliable type of statistical average.
______ are considered to be the most flexible and useful.
multiple choice items
The multiple choice items are considered to be the most flexible and useful.
______ are used by the teachers for the formative evaluation of pupils.
Formative tests
Formative tests are used by the teachers for the formative evaluation of pupils.
______ is used for converting raw scores obtained from standardized tests into nine categories.
stanine scored
The stanine scored is used for converting raw scores obtained from standardized tests into nine categories.
______ is the mid point of a set of scores.
median
The median is the mid point of a set of scores.
______ are called standard scores when they are based on the standard deviation.
Transformed scores
Transformed scores are called standard scores when they are based on the standard deviation.
______ is a diagram or visual representation of the socio-metric choices within a group.
sociogram
A sociogram is a diagram or visual representation of the socio-metric choices within a group.
______ are the Mean, the Median and the Mode.
three measures
The three measures are the Mean, the Median and the Mode.
